method: USENIX serves these pages behind a browser challenge, so they were read in a browser session. For each year, the rows under the "USENIX Security '<yy>" and "WOOT '<yy>" headings of the listing were copied as [event, year, title, presentation URL, award]; the award is the badge on that paper's presentation page. Every page answered 200. Badges that also name an Internet Defense Prize keep only the conference award, and the one page naming both a Distinguished Paper and a Distinguished Artifact Award is recorded with the paper award.
